content: .{@-दग्ध@} {%a.%} .²1 burnt on the funeral pile; अग्निदग्धाश्च ये जीवा येऽप्यदग्धाः कुले मम <ls>Vāyu P.</ls> .²2 burnt with fire. .²3 burnt at once without having fire put into the mouth, being destitute of issue (?); (<ab>pl.</ab>) a class of Manes or Pitṛs who, when alive, kept up the household flame and presented oblations of fire.
